natural_body: Price-sensitive SMB 40% off: signups +31%, revenue +18%, retention -12%; renewals weak.

first.rationale: I intend to test onboarding simplification because onboarding completion and activation are both declining, and prior evidence suggests shortening onboarding and reducing signup friction improve early adoption. The experiment should include guardrails for qualified pipeline, conversion quality, retention, and time-to-value so higher completion does not mask weaker downstream revenue.
